newsitem.title: USA: Coach USA files for 3.1 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Coach USA files for 3.1 mln shr offering.

text.p: Motorcoach charter and tour service provider Coach USA said on Friday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of 3.1 million shares of common stock.
The company will use the proceeds to retire debt from six recent acquisitions and to pay for future acquisitions.
The company said it would sell two million shares and various Coach shareholders would sell 1.1 million shares.
Underwriters Alex. Brown & Sons Inc and Smith Barney had an option to buy up to 465,000 additional shares. It said the offering was expected to be made in November.
